description: Five trained query-conditioned bilinear attention models. Primitive and AND query rows/sequence states/token edits only fit exact orthogonal head gauges. XOR queries are an entirely withheld composition family for featurizer fitting. Per-example top-|coordinate| gating retains 2/4/6 of eight axes; complete gauges preserve native head output exactly. Compare physical heads, weight/sequence PCA, weight/sequence/edit varimax, and eight random rotations. Evaluate fresh uniform and shifted-token sequences.
